content: Gìr'mur'mwana mala sǎ mala doshi
Pǝlǝa Yahweh ne Musa ama, <<Nyare aban Firona Murǝm. Ən tsǝ́ngŋǝ̀nà murcandǝa a ɓabumi andǝ ɓabum aɓwana-mǝgule male, ace mǝnana mǝ lǝmdǝ agir'ndali mem aɓalǝia ka.
Mǝ nǝ pàk mǝno yì gìr ka ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu banggi amuna wun andǝ amǝ'kà wun, ulang ɓangginǝban mǝnana ǝn ɓangginǝ amǝ Masar,
andǝ agir-lǝmdǝa mǝnana ǝn pea, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu sǝlǝ ama mǝ nda Yahweh ka.>>

Nda Musa andǝ Haruna wari aban Firona Murǝm à kya banggi wi ama, <<Yahweh Ɓakuli mala amǝ Ibǝru kǝ na ama, <Nǝ̀ sau lang sǝ awu nǝ ginǝ nongsǝmuro abanam? Nying aɓwana mem ɓǝà o, ace mǝnana ɓǝà kya peri abanam ngga.
Sǝ ɓǝ̀ a ɓinǝ nying aɓwana mem ɓǝà u ka, loasǝ mǝsǝo, lí ka mǝ ndo mǝ nǝ sulǝ doshi amur nzali ma'wun.

À nǝ̀ gìr múr nzali ma'wun, yàle pà wu nǝ̀ gandǝ sǝn nzǝm nzali ɗang ace ɓiki lakkì malea. À nǝ̀ lì gìr mǝnana kat talimbulo nyî kiɗiki raka, sǝ à nǝ̀ kpǝri koya nggun mǝnana ueo kǝ gulo aɓa nzali ma'wun ngga.

À nǝ̀ yia lùmsǝ palta mô, andǝ aɓala mala amǝtúró mô, andǝ mala aɓwana mala nzali Masar kat. Ɓike malea nǝ̀ kàrmúr gir kat, mǝnana atár wun andǝ aká wun ɓara-ɓara sǝni, twal a do malea a nzali mǝnia yi puro a yalung ngga.> >> Sǝ Musa wulio, upi ɓadǝm Firona.

Aɓwana-mǝgule mala Firona yiu à yi banggi wi ama, <<Nǝ̀ sau lang sǝ ɓwabura man nǝ̀ nggǝ pá sǝm tanni anggo? Nying aɓwana mǝno ɓǝà o, ace mǝnana ɓǝà kya peri aban Yahweh Ɓakuli malea! A sǝlǝ mbak ama, Masar kiɗikina?>>
Nda à nyesǝ Musa andǝ Haruna a ɓadǝm Firona, sǝ yi banggia wia ama, <<Wu kyane, wu kya peri aban Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun! Sǝ nggeari kǎ, ayana ɗe aɓalǝ wun mǝnana à nǝ̀ u ka?>>

Musa pǝlǝi wi ama, <<Sǝm kat sǝ sǝm nǝ̀ o, alo-ɓwa andǝ akapana, amuna-burana ma'sǝm, andǝ amuna-mamǝna ma'sǝm, anzur ma'sǝm, andǝ ambul-pǝndǝa ma'sǝm, andǝ andá ma'sǝm. Dumǝna púp sǝm kat sǝm nǝ̀ nggá pàk lamsan ace gusǝlǝ Yahweh.>>

Pǝlǝa Firona nea wia ama, <<She ɓǝ̀ Yahweh nǝ̀ bwala wun kàm aɓa kàne ma'wun mǝna ka, sǝama pà mǝ nǝ nying wun, wun nǝ̀ umnǝ amamǝna andǝ amuna ma'wun ɗàng! Acemǝnana ǝn sǝni ka, wu nda rǝ pak kutan mala mgbicau.
Pà mǝ nǝ eara wun anggo ɗàng. Kǝ aburana na à nǝ̀ ká peri aban Yahweh ka, acemǝnana mǝno nda gìr mǝnana wu zǝmba cè ka.>> Firona pǝlǝa pǝr Musa andǝ Haruna ɓǝà nying ɓadǝmbi.
Pǝlǝa Yahweh ne Musa ama, <<Sárǝ́ buo amur nzali Masar ɓǝ̀ doshi sulǝo amurí ɓǝ̀ lì koya girpwala andǝ gir mǝnana kat talimbulo nyî ka.>>
Nda Musa lǝmdǝ gara male amur nzali Masar, sǝ Yahweh loasǝ gung nǝ takuli yi ɓua amur nzali. Pwari andǝ du kat gung na ban ɓua. Lang bân nǝ kwar ka, gung takuli yina nǝ adoshi.
Doshi yiu amur nzali Masar kat, yi sulǝo aki ɓá nzali Masar kat. Sulǝo mala doshi nggǝm-nggǝm mǝno ka, à malaká sǝn ulangnì ɗàng, sǝ à pà nǝ̀ nyare à nǝ̀ sǝn ulangnì ɗǝm ɗàng.

À gìr nzǝm-nzali kat, gandǝa nzali pǝlǝ mǝpǝndǝe. À lì girpwala mǝnana a bondo ka kat, andǝ aɓǝla anggun mǝnana talimbulo kúmsǝia raka. Kǝ mbúgir mǝpwale ue ɗǝm amur anggun andǝ bondo aɓa nzali Masar ɗàng.
Firona pǝlǝa túrban akaurǝa ɓǝà tunǝ Musa andǝ Haruna sǝ na ama, <<Ən pángŋǝ́nì Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun cauɓikea, sǝ ǝn pángŋǝ̀nà wun cauɓikea.
Ado ka, wu twàlâm-ban cauɓikea mem ɗǝm, sǝ wu zǝmbî Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun ɓǝ̀ twàlâm-ban mǝnia yì lú ka.>>
Musa pǝlǝa nying ban Firona Murǝm sǝ kya pakhiwi aban Yahweh.
Pǝlǝa Yahweh ɓua gung mǝcandǝe tò nǝ njar-nzali, pwan doshi umnǝi a Nggeamùr Nzuno. Kǝ doshi mwashat ueo ɗǝm a koya ban aɓa nzali Masar ɗàng.
Sǝ Yahweh ka tsǝk murǝm múrí candǝ ɗǝm, ginǝ nying amǝ Isǝrayila ɓǝà o.
Gìr'mur'mwana mala pǝndǝa
Yahweh ne Musa ama, <<Loasǝ buo a kùli ace mǝnana pǝndǝa mǝcikcikì, mǝnana à nǝ̀ gandǝ ue nǝ bu ka, ɓǝ̀ gìr mur nzali Masar.>>
Musa pǝlǝa loasǝ bui a kùli sǝ pǝndǝa mǝcikcikì kara ak nzali Masar kat nongŋo tàrú.
Kǝ ɓwa gandǝ sǝn ɓì atà amǝ Masar ɗàng, sǝ kǝ ɓwa gandǝ nying ɓala male aɓalǝ amǝno yì apwari ka ɗàng. Sǝama a bu bando mala amǝ Isǝrayila ka, tǎlaban nakam.
Pǝlǝa Firona Murǝm tunǝ Musa ne wi ama, <<Wu o, wu kya peri aban Yahweh; amamǝna andǝ amuna ma'wun ɓǝà kyane. Sǝama anzur ma'wun, andǝ ambul-pǝndǝa ma'wun, andǝ andá ma'wun ngga ɓǝà ueo kani.>>
Sǝ Musa ka nyesǝi wi ama, <<Dumǝna púp awu nǝ nying sǝm ɓǝ̀ sǝm umnǝ agirkusǝu andǝ apagir mala pisǝe kǝring a bù sǝm, mǝnana sǝm nǝ̀ nggá pà aban Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'sǝm ngga.

Agirkusǝu ma'sǝm nǝ̀ o atà sǝm. Pa sǝm nǝ̀ nying kǝ nkaulakusǝ girkusǝu anzǝ́mò ɗàng. Aɓalǝia sǝ sǝm nǝ̀ twal amǝnana sǝm nǝ̀ nggá pana gir'nkila nǝia aban Yahweh ka. Sǝ pà sǝm nǝ̀ súrǝ̀ ya girkusǝu na sǝm nǝ̀ pana gir'nkila nǝi ka ɗàng, she ɓǝ̀ sǝm bwalǝna ka.>>
Yahweh nyare candǝ múr Firona, ginǝ nying amǝ Isǝrayila ɓǝà o.
Firona ne Musa ama, <<Puro nying ɓadǝmbam! Cè a nyare a yiu ama awu nǝ sǝnam ɗǝm ɗàng! Pwari mǝnana a sǝn ɓamǝsǝam ɗǝm ngga, awu nǝ wú!>>
Musa ne wi ama, <<Cau mǝnana a ne ka, nda jik, pà mǝ nǝ sǝn ɓamǝsǝo ɗǝm ɗàng.>>
